payload.rebuttal: fixed: Added three assertions inside test_a_rebut_the_cap_cut_short_ends_exhausted_with_its_blockers_standing (tests/test_session.py), applied to every cut-short shape (a, b, c, and the separate d run): outcome.spent_usd == ledger.task_spend(outcome.task_id), the emitted Budget event's value == outcome.spent_usd, and its limit == 0.25. ledger.task_spend reads the real cost_usd_est recorded per attempt row, independent of the host's own running `spent` variable, so it catches exactly the mutant named in the finding: changing `spent += result.cost_usd` to `spent += 0.0 if (cap is not None and cap.refused) else result.cost_usd` now makes outcome.spent_usd (0.75) diverge from ledger.task_spend (8.00) and the test fails. I verified this by applying that exact mutant to saffron/cell/session.py and confirming the new assertion fails with that exact mismatch, then reverted it and confirmed the full suite (3106 tests) and the prose/lint/format/types gates are all green with the fix in place.
